title: PeridotID Relayer H1 (ANT-582)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute',"createdAt") AS time, COALESCE(metadata->>'chain','unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS revocations FROM security_events WHERE "eventType" IN ('credential.rotated','credential.revoked') AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT COALESCE(metadata->>'cause','unknown') AS cause, COUNT(*) AS rejections FROM security_events WHERE "eventType"='intent.rejected' AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1;

SELECT "createdAt" AS time, "eventType", COALESCE(metadata->>'chain','unknown') AS chain, metadata FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt") AND ("eventType" IN ('relayer.formula_mismatch','relayer.over_attested') OR ("eventType" LIKE '%.reconciled' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'overAttested')::boolean,false) OR (metadata->>'protocolFee') IS DISTINCT FROM (metadata->>'protocolFeeExpected')))) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: P4 relayer absorbed/min per chain vs cap (H1-iv)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute',"createdAt") AS time, COALESCE(metadata->>'chain','unknown') AS metric, SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'absorbed',''),NULLIF(metadata->>'relayerAbsorbed',''),'0')::numeric) AS absorbed FROM security_events WHERE ("eventType"='relayer.pnl' OR "eventType" LIKE '%.reconciled') AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('minute',"createdAt") AS time, COALESCE(metadata->>'chain','unknown')||'/'||COALESCE(metadata->>'entryPoint','unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS drifts FROM security_events WHERE "eventType"='quote.drift_rejected' AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COALESCE(metadata->>'chain','unknown') AS chain, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (metadata->>'latencyMs')::numeric) AS p50_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (metadata->>'latencyMs')::numeric) AS p95_ms, COUNT(*) AS n FROM security_events WHERE "eventType"='rotation.confirmed_latency' AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1;

SELECT "eventType" AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS events FROM security_events WHERE "eventType" IN ('broadcast.resolved_landed','broadcast.resolved_not_landed_rebroadcast','broadcast.parked_unreadable','broadcast.duplicate_suppressed','broadcast.rebroadcast','broadcast.conflicting_bytes_rejected','relayer.parked') AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1;

SELECT "createdAt" AS time, COALESCE(metadata->>'chain','unknown') AS metric, CASE WHEN "eventType"='relayer.breaker.opened' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS open FROM security_events WHERE "eventType" IN ('relayer.breaker.opened','relayer.breaker.closed') AND $__timeFilter("createdAt") ORDER BY 1;

notes: Import: Grafana -> Dashboards -> New -> Import, paste this file. Select the Postgres datasource serving the app DB (read-only user). Panels mirror docs/RELAYER_DASHBOARDS.md; alerts live in deploy/alerts/relayer-h1-check.sh (cron 5m), not in Grafana.
